# 3ngram v1.1.1

Patch release: make the runtime row-level-security guard's expected database
role configurable.

## Changes

- The runtime RLS readiness guard (`GET /ready`) now reads the expected
  `current_user` from the `RUNTIME_DB_ROLE` environment variable, defaulting to
  `app_user`. A deployment whose runtime connects as a differently-named
  `NOBYPASSRLS` role now passes readiness instead of failing on a hardcoded
  role name. No behavior change when `RUNTIME_DB_ROLE` is unset.

## Release artifacts

- `@3ngram/server@1.1.1`, `@3ngram/sdk@1.1.1`, and `3ngram@1.1.1` on npm
- `@3ngram/core@0.6.1` and `@3ngram/db@0.6.1` on npm
- `ghcr.io/b3dmar/3ngram:1.1.1` for Linux amd64 and arm64
- BuildKit SBOM plus provenance and GitHub-signed SLSA attestations

The hosted 3ngram dashboard and cloud-operations code are proprietary and are
not included in this repository. The MCP server, REST API, SDK, CLI, and memory
engine do not depend on that dashboard.
